name: goblin_smuggler_target_pumped_after_resolution_stays_unblockable
notes: P8d05e3123b G4. Printed: '{T}: Another target creature with power 2 or less can't be blocked this turn.' 'With power 2 or less' is a targeting requirement, checked when the ability is activated and as it resolves (CR 601.2c, 608.2b); once it has resolved, the target can't be blocked this turn whatever its power becomes (CR 611.2c; Goblin Tunneler / Goblin Smuggler rulings). Seat 0 controls Goblin Oriflamme ('Attacking creatures you control get +1/+0'). The Smuggler targets your 2/2 (legal: power 2), which then attacks as a 3/2: seat 1's untapped 4/4 is never offered a block and the 3/2 deals 3.
